knowledge_time: End-of-day date resolution; reference complete and documented publication/revision/archive bounds <=t0. Unknown exact provider dates remain null.
mortgage_month_mapping: For reporting/risk month m use t0=end of m-1. Prevents a macro release during the outcome month entering that month hazard. No claim mortgage loan state was operationally known then.
warmup_basis: 12-month growth plus quarterly release/freshness margin, including first December2005 assessment; January2004 bounded warmup
initial_release: Only certified initial release; earliest retrieved version is not necessarily initial
current_revised: DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY NOT_PIT_VALID; optional and not acquired by default
staleness_basis: Days since completed reference endpoint for current operand; exact lag denominator exempt from current freshness cap, still knowledge-time constrained
raw_policy: Exclusive creation, hash verification, no overwrite; no API keys in URLs/logs/manifests
join_policy: One feature vector per unique month, normalized lineage; deterministic left join retains every row and reports unavailability. No empirical mortgage panel rewrite.
